messages.content:
You audit a SIMULATED CALLER (an AI playing a patient) in a test call to a customer-service agent. You are not grading the agent.
The caller has a brief: the facts it knows and WHEN it is allowed to reveal each one.
- "upfront": may say any time.
- "only_if_asked": may say only when the agent's previous turn asks something this fact directly answers.
- "at_trigger": may say only from the turn it was unlocked (shown as "unlocked at turn N"), not before.
Find:
1. LEAKS: the caller stated a brief fact before it was allowed. "major" if an at_trigger fact came early or an only_if_asked fact was volunteered in a way that would change what the agent should do; "minor" otherwise.
2. INVENTED facts: the caller stated a specific fact that is NOT in its brief or persona: a name, number, date, drug, dose, store, address or symptom. "major" if it could change what the agent should do; "minor" for harmless color. Not invented: small talk, feelings, "I don't know", or repeating/confirming what the agent said.
Not leaks: correcting something the agent got wrong (the caller must correct a wrong read-back once), or answering what the agent just asked.
Lines marked "(scenario-scripted)" are written by the scenario author, not improvised: they are never leaks or invented facts, and whatever they state counts as part of the brief from then on.
Be strict but fair; when in doubt, it's fine.
Reply with JSON only: {"leaks": [{"turn": N, "fact": "<which brief fact>", "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "<caller words>", "why": "<short>"}], "invented": [{"turn": N, "severity": "major"|"minor", "quote": "...", "why": "..."}]}

CALLER BRIEF:
Persona: Jamal Carter, patient. 31, just moved to Lakeview, busy and impatient; values speed and hates being re-asked things.
Facts:
- Name Jamal Carter, DOB 1995-03-14, Rx# 7004512, sertraline, store H-302 [upfront]
- Phone 555-0177 [only_if_asked, the agent NEVER asked]
- Missed yesterday's sertraline dose [at_trigger, unlocked at turn 2]
- New insurance card hasn't arrived; wants to know the cash price [at_trigger, unlocked at turn 3]

TRANSCRIPT:
[turn 1] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Hi, Jamal Carter, March 14th, 1995, refill on Rx 7004512, the sertraline, at the Main St University store.
[turn 1] AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then queue that refill for you. Great, Jamal. I'm queuing that sertraline refill at the Main St University store now. Perfect. Your sertraline refill is queued and will be ready tomorrow, Friday, at ten in the morning at the Main St University store.
[turn 2] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Oh, and I missed yesterday's dose. Can I just take two today to catch up?
[turn 2] AGENT: That's a dosing question, so you'll need to check with your prescriber about that. They know your treatment plan best. Would you like me to flag our pharmacist to give you a call about it?
[turn 3] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Sure, that's fine. Also, how much is it going to be? My new insurance card hasn't come in yet.
[turn 3] AGENT: I'll get a pharmacist to call you about the missed dose question. As for pricing and insurance, I don't have access to that information, but our pharmacy staff can help you with that when you pick up tomorrow or if you call back. They'll be able to look up your coverage once your new card arrives too.
[turn 4] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Ugh, fine. I'll message Dr. Nair.
[turn 4] AGENT: Sounds good. Your refill will be ready tomorrow at ten, and our pharmacist will be calling you about the dose question too. Anything else I can help with?
[turn 5] CALLER (scenario-scripted): Fine, have them call me. That's it, thanks.

JSON only.
